vcu_g_0159_20001fa0.name: motor_drive_flags
vcu_g_0159_20001fa0.description: Drive flag word. vcu_drive_command_update sets bits 0 and 1 to 3 when 0x20001e62 is below 21 (below 11 for profiles other than 0 and 3) and clears them otherwise, with a second threshold at 25 (or 15) for the clear path. can_get_tx_payload_for_id puts its low byte in byte 6 of CAN frame 0x20c and then overwrites the high byte with 0x2000123d.

vcu_g_0159_20001fb0.name: motor_setpoint_scaled
vcu_g_0159_20001fb0.description: Scaled level setpoint, motor_level_setpoint * 6000 (32-bit signed). vcu_drive_command_update recomputes it when the setpoint changes. The state routines vcu_0159_0800a15c, vcu_0159_0800a1d0 and vcu_0159_0800a55c pass it to FUN_08003b00 (probably the drive's torque or current reference).

vcu_g_153_20001fcc.name: motor_drive_state_b153_1fcc
vcu_g_153_20001fcc.description: Build 152/153 byte in the drive state block, written by vcu_drive_command_update through a base pointer. The decompile does not name the address directly, so its meaning is not established.

vcu_g_0159_20001fe9.name: motor_timeout_limit
vcu_g_0159_20001fe9.description: Timeout limit selected from motor_timeout_select: 30 for 0, 15 for 1 and 5 for 2. vcu_drive_command_update writes it, and the counters 0x20001378, 0x2000137a and 0x20001376 in vcu_0159_080047ac are compared against it. The unit is probably seconds or 100 ms steps.

vcu_g_0159_20001fee.name: motor_tx_byte_fee
vcu_g_0159_20001fee.description: Byte 7 of CAN frame 0x184 (the high byte of the 16-bit field at 0x20001852). vcu_drive_command_update sets it from FUN_08001320() (probably a measured value), from bits 9..15 of 0x20001f96, or to 0 according to the low bits of 0x20001b94. The override is 0x200020b0.

vcu_g_0159_20001fef.name: motor_tx_byte_fef
vcu_g_0159_20001fef.description: Byte 0 of CAN frame 0x184. vcu_drive_command_update sets it to 0x14 (20) for profiles 1, 2 and 5 and to 0x22 (34) for the other profiles. The override is 0x200020b4.

vcu_g_0159_200020a4.name: motor_tx_override
vcu_g_0159_200020a4.description: Override block for the CAN transmit fields (see the MotorTxOverride struct). Each value replaces its field only while its enable byte is nonzero. The block is applied at the end of vcu_drive_command_update.
